title: glandulifera clava
intro: Glandulifera clava, commonly known as Chinese lavender, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Glandulifera clava include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly linalool and linalyl acetate, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
